card.name: Linking word in Lactic Acidosis heading
card.fires_on: The word 'and' (or a slash) right after 'Lactic Acidosis' in the warnings heading 'Lactic Acidosis and Severe Hepatomegaly with Steatosis'. It also fires on 'prolonged' in a nearby risk-factor sentence.

modes.label: Heading link
modes.description: 'and' or '/' joining 'Lactic Acidosis' to 'Severe Hepatomegaly' in a numbered warning heading.

modes.label: Risk-factor sentence
modes.description: 'prolonged' in a sentence on obesity and nucleoside exposure as risk factors.
modes.example: Obesity and<< prolonged>> nucleoside exposure may be risk factors
